summary.text: Alec Pavlik, a write-in candidate with no party affiliation, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 6th Congressional District to Randy Fine, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
In his Ballotpedia survey he lists constitutional law, tax policy, and policies affecting natural rights as his areas of interest, along with copyright and corporate law.

sources.title: Alec Pavlik - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
